title: One-Year vs. Two-Year MBA Global Comparator
description: Three-path NPV comparator (1-yr international MBA, 2-yr US MBA, no MBA) modeling the three mechanics generic calculators miss: opportunity-cost asymmetry (10 vs 21 months out), career-switch feasibility gates (no-internship double switch ×0.60), and geo-placement gates (e.g., INSEAD <10% US placement). Embedded 12-program table, visa hard-stop logic, payback year, geo-fit scoring.
data_vintage: 2025–26 class profiles & published fees · school employment reports 2024–25 · GMAC application trends
regulatory_citations: 2025–26 class profiles & published fees (INSEAD, LBS, IESE, HEC, Oxford, Cambridge, Kellogg, Columbia, Cornell)
School employment reports 2024–25 (placement geography: INSEAD, LBS, US M7/T15 composites)
GMAC Prospective Students Survey & Application Trends Survey 2024–25
8 CFR 214.2(f) F-1 OPT / STEM OPT regulations

mcp_tool_definition.name: compare_mba_format_geography
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare 1-year international vs 2-year US MBA vs no-MBA paths with opportunity-cost, switch-feasibility, and geo-placement gates. Returns 10-yr NPV per path, payback year, geo-fit score, switch-gate multipliers, expected gated year-1 salary, and visa hard-stop warnings.

current_salary.description: Current annual salary in USD — drives opportunity cost

target_geography.description: Target post-MBA geography; placement-share gate scales expected salary realization

career_goal.description: accelerate = same track; single = switch industry OR function; double = switch both (×0.60 gate without internship)

citizenship.description: Non-US + US target + non-US program = visa hard stop (no F-1 OPT pathway)

program_a.description: 1-year/accelerated program id: insead, lbs, iese, hec, oxford, cambridge, kellogg1y, cbsjterm, cornell1y

program_b.description: 2-year US program id: usm7, ust15, ust25

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate as decimal (default 0.05, real terms)

output_schema.paths: array of {path, program, npv, opportunity_cost, tuition_fees, payback_year, geo_fit_score, switch_gate, expected_year1_salary}
output_schema.visa_blocked_path_a: boolean — non-US citizen targeting US via program with no OPT pathway
